COLDWAR_SWE_national_update_focus_progress_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_chapter_deep_riksdag
			}
			OR = {
				has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SWE_riksdag_1
				has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SWE_riksdag_2
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_chapter_deep_riksdag
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_chapter_deep_labour
			}
			OR = {
				has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SWE_labour_1
				has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SWE_labour_2
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_chapter_deep_labour
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_chapter_deep_welfare
			}
			OR = {
				has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SWE_welfare_0
				has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SWE_welfare_1
				has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SWE_welfare_2
				has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SWE_welfare_3
				has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SWE_welfare_4
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_chapter_deep_welfare
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_chapter_deep_steel

			}

						is_owned_by = ROOT
						is_controlled_by = ROOT
						NOT = {
							has_dynamic_modifier = {
								modifier = COLDWAR_SWE_northern_universities
							}
						}
					}
					add_dynamic_modifier = {
						modifier = COLDWAR_SWE_northern_universities
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_delivered_regional
			}
			33 = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_owned_by = ROOT
						is_controlled_by = ROOT
						NOT = {
							has_dynamic_modifier = {
								modifier = COLDWAR_SWE_northern_development
							}
						}
					}
					add_dynamic_modifier = {
						modifier = COLDWAR_SWE_northern_development
					}
				}
			}
			442 = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_owned_by = ROOT
						is_controlled_by = ROOT
						NOT = {
							has_dynamic_modifier = {
								modifier = COLDWAR_SWE_northern_development
							}
						}
					}
					add_dynamic_modifier = {
						modifier = COLDWAR_SWE_northern_development
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_delivered_regional_university
					}
					AND = {
						33 = {
							has_dynamic_modifier = {
								modifier = COLDWAR_SWE_northern_universities
							}
						}
						442 = {
							has_dynamic_modifier = {
								modifier = COLDWAR_SWE_northern_universities
							}
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_delivered_regional
					}
					AND = {
						33 = {
							has_dynamic_modifier = {
								modifier = COLDWAR_SWE_northern_development
							}
						}
						442 = {
							has_dynamic_modifier = {
								modifier = COLDWAR_SWE_northern_development
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = {
				flag = COLDWAR_SWE_requested_rewards_migrated_v1
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}
}
